task.title: Palette All-cards place and collection breadcrumb still target /my (list on phones) — same class P6-154 fixed on the rail
task.description: Flagged during P6-166 (2026-08-13): the K palette's All cards place (palette.rs PlaceKey::AllCards) and the collection page's breadcrumb All-cards link both navigate to /my, which post-P6-166 is the ROOT LIST on phones — the same two-tap surprise P6-154 fixed on the rail's pinned row by retargeting to /my/all. Both are client-side navigations (no SSR concern). Retarget both to /my/all, minding P6-154's note that the desktop mode-switch deliberately remains the one /my click path (resource-collision guard) — these two are not that path.
